description.en: The list of device configuration information.

description.zh:
配置内容，可以选择传入：

- 配置内容文本。格式请参见[设备配置说明](~~172319~~)。
- 存储配置文件的阿里云对象存储（OSS）地址。

> 单次调用最多可填写20个配置信息。
description.en:
The configuration content. You can pass one of the following:

- Configuration text. For the format, see [Device Configuration Guide](~~172319~~).
- The Object Storage Service (OSS) URL where the configuration file is stored.

> You can specify up to 20 configuration entries in a single call.

description.zh:
设备ID。

可调用[QueryEdgeInstanceDevice](~~135261~~)查询实例中的设备ID。

> 单次调用最多可填写20个设备ID。
description.en:
The Device ID.

You can call the [QueryEdgeInstanceDevice](~~135261~~) API to query the device IDs in the instance.

> You can specify up to 20 device IDs in a single call.

description.zh:
边缘实例ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The ID of the edge instance. You can obtain the ID by moving the mouse pointer over the name of the target edge instance on the **Edge Instances** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) API to obtain the ID.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The instance ID. Do not pass this parameter for public instances. Pass this parameter for Enterprise instances.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。
> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Conditions
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 5 queries per second (QPS) to call this API.
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot batch-set-edge-instance-device-config --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id F3APY0tPLhmgGtx00000 --device-configs IotId=sjI0Sd124XFYyjBY0000000101 Content=test_:_device_config_demo --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot BatchSetEdgeInstanceDeviceConfig --region cn-hangzhou --DeviceConfigs.1.IotId sjI0Sd124XFYyjBY0000000101 --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --InstanceId F3APY0tPLhmgGtx00000 --DeviceConfigs.1.Content 'test_:_device_config_demo'
